name: desktop-headless-browser-e2e
goal: Default Desktop E2E runs all browser UI cases in headless Chromium without launching Electron; native acceptance remains separately available.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Updated the existing test-preview feature spec: default E2E is headless Chromium, native acceptance stays explicit, preview isolation remains required.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5/xhigh added Chromium and native Playwright projects, separate scripts and README guidance; all existing E2E specs and assertions remain unchanged.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Added a config-boundary guard to test-preview-refusal.test.ts; focused Desktop tests 3/3 pass, and the headless chromium E2E project passes all 200 tests. Native project retains its one test.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Full root bun run check passed with exit 0, including Desktop check, build, and 200/200 headless Chromium E2E tests. Focused Desktop unit coverage also passed 3/3, and native Electron acceptance remains separately invokable and was not launched.
